staticRules.rule: Bundle membership comes from Renderer.props_layout.target_props.items. getPropBundleInfo maps each listed child ID to its parent and excludes child IDs from the outer index_list. It does not infer membership from labels or adjacency.
Display sorting uses numeric display_order if any relevant display order is truthy; otherwise the existing prop list is returned. This is not a runtime keyboard-focus algorithm.

Checked ApplyWidget renumbers independently inside every definition. Child props in the reverse bundle map are skipped at outer traversal. Bundle parents use their target_props.items order; an empty items array takes the bundle branch with no numbered child. Only existing focus_order attributes receive numbers. Unchecked preserves values.

getConfigProps expands the selected outer bundle to matching child props in source_sorted_props order and marks their prop indicator readonly. This configuration expansion order differs in source from ApplyWidget items order; they must not be collapsed into one inferred order.

Adding a bundle copies its props_layout and optional line_merge and assigns appended child focus_order after the current maximum. Newly added props include bundle child IDs. This does not establish the existing request-specific bundle map.

SetGridItemProgram obtains attribute settings for widget grid, menu subtype, template set and item_separate_tf. With separated items, THEAD settings can request TBODY. It resolves children by matching association_prop plus section_type or exact prop_id and preserves table row/column mapping.
